capabilities: Open a matching [[tag]] page when a tag is clicked in Reading view or Live Preview
Create the missing Markdown page, including parent folders for nested tags
Resolve tag targets through frontmatter alias and aliases values
Classify tag mentions into the linked-backlinks list
Suggest note names and aliases as page completion when typing #
extras: The manifest carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice; install is via BRAT or manual file download, and tag clicks do not work in Source mode. Repository is named obsdian-tag-to-page while the plugin ID remains tag-to-page.
intentEvidence: changes tag clicks from Obsidian's default tag-search behavior into page navigation
problem: In Obsidian, clicking a #tag only triggers a search; there is no built-in way to make tags navigate to a dedicated page like Logseq does.

relations.evidence: Make #tags behave more like Logseq: click a tag to open its matching [[tag]] page.

summary: Tag-click interceptor that opens the matching [[tag]] page instead of running a tag search, creating the page when it does not exist.
